SUPO, where required) Why this application matters This is not a live vacancy. It is how we meet talented people before the right role exists. We open new roles in GMO all the time, and strong candidates are rarely on the market for long. Apply once, tell us what you do best and what you want next, and when a role matches your profile, we will contact you. Applying does not guarantee contact. We review applications monthly. Please submit your CV or resume in English, as we cannot review applications in other languages. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Application Process 1. Upload your CV or resume in English and fill in a short form 2. You receive an automatic confirmation 3. We contact you when a matching role opens and move you into that role’s process 4. If there is no match yet, your profile stays in our talent pool for 12 months, as long as you gave permission Working at ICEYE At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES - Own day-to-day customs clearance across the EU: release for circulation, outward/inward processing, transit (T1, T2, TIR), customs warehousing, bonded storage and temporary admission. - Maintain HS/Taric classification and customs valuation for both supplier-sourced and in-house manufactured goods. - Spot risks in international shipments early and resolve them before they reach destinations. - Understand and apply Incoterms with confidence, allocating cost, risk and responsibility correctly across every lane. - Prepare for and take part in customs audits, and help strengthen the internal audit and control programme. - Run Binding Tariff Information (BTI) applications regularly and keep the resulting rulings current. - Write clear SOPs that colleagues can follow without you having to explain them. - Pursue free trade agreement benefits (preferential origin, EUR.1, statements on origin, REX registration) and maintain the supplier declaration chain. - Track and report the impact of your work: duty avoided, duty recovered and landed cost reduced. - Contribute to Freight Forwarding strategy across road, air and sea, flagging where routing, mode or documentation choices affect customs treatment or cost. - Recognise dangerous goods shipments (IATA DGR, ADR, IMDG) and check the required documentation. - Support material flow between ICEYE's Espoo site and our sites worldwide, reconciling physical goods against ERP, WMS and TMS records. Beyond mission planning, you will contribute across the Operations team: preparing and executing flight test campaigns, supporting ground control station operations, assessing flight results and feeding them back into the aircraft's development, and helping build the procedures and tools of an operations capability that will scale as the program grows.
